root_definition: SHA-256 of the exact registry.json bytes; the registry binds policy and task-manifest digests, and each task manifest binds its public contract and other artifacts
authorization_boundary: ymp-corpus records the exact technical root but neither ingests nor authenticates an owner decision; authorization is resolved in the external project governance channel

public_requirements: BSTR-EOF: an empty BufRead buffer ends record iteration without another read or an emitted record
BSTR-DEBUG: invalid UTF-8 bytes in BStr Debug output use two lowercase hexadecimal digits
SEMVER-LT: a partial less-than comparator excludes prereleases at its minor-version boundary
SEMVER-LTE: a partial less-than-or-equal comparator includes named-minor stable releases but excludes boundary prereleases
JSON-SURROGATE-STATE: byte-buffer escape parsing resumes immediately after a lone surrogate without weakening invalid-input rejection
TOML-LEAP-SECOND: seconds value 60 is accepted and greater values are rejected
TOML-CALENDAR-DAY: date validation applies Gregorian month lengths and leap-year rules
